privacy.summary: Learning progress, nickname and age range are stored only on this device (localStorage) and never uploaded. AI chats send text and age range (for age-appropriate content), but never the child's name.
privacy.voiceNotice: Read-aloud & voice features use the browser's local speech recognition; voice is never uploaded or stored on servers.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data
privacy.subtitle: How we collect, store and protect your child's data
privacy.collectDesc: Stored only on this device: learning progress, nickname, avatar, age range. AI chats send text and age range to the server to generate content, but never the child's name.
privacy.voiceFull: Read-aloud assessment and voice chat use the browser's local speech recognition (Web Speech API); voice is processed locally only and never uploaded or stored. If we ever add cloud voice services, we will ask for your separate consent.
privacy.retainDesc: Data stays on this device by default and can be cleared in one tap below. Backup files are exported by you and never contain the child's name or PIN.
privacy.consentPending: Privacy notice not yet confirmed (can confirm in first-run setup)
privacy.clearDesc: Deletes all learning progress, profiles and settings on this device (including backup signature). This cannot be undone.
